title: Sheerline instance manifest (instance.yaml)
description: One practice's instance of the Sheerline scaffold: who it is, where its design-system contract and MCP build record live, and the value it fills each scaffold slot with. Read by sheerline/os/instance/resolve.py (stdlib only), which enforces the same rules this schema states.

id.description: A non-identifying instance id. Blank in the template.

kind.description: self: the practice's own instance. client: an instance the practice runs for a client.

mode.description: pointer: slot fills are repo-relative paths to where the values already sit (instance 0 only, as the expand step). rooted: every fill lives under the instance root.

owner.description: Who ratifies this instance's values. Blank in the template.

client_roots.description: Repo-relative folders where this practice keeps client data (read from the practice's registered self instances only). A pointer-mode fill may never sit under one; pointer fills are refused when no registered self instance declares any.

intake.description: Path to the filled engagement-intake.yaml (rooted: intake/engagement-intake.yaml).

data_dir.description: The DS-MCP data contract this instance serves (rooted: contract/).

alias_registry.description: Optional: a flat JSON registry whose top-level keys are the component-facing token names the contract serves. The export's token-name scan reads it alongside data_dir/tokens.dtcg.json.

served_as.description: The served contract's name or brand override.

build_record.description: The MCP build record directory (rooted: mcp/).

history.description: The instance's history directory (rooted: history/). History slots are filled under slots.

slots.description: Keyed by slot id from sheerline/os/instance/slots.yaml. An absent slot resolves to its generic default.

value.description: The file holding this instance's value.

evidence.description: Files that back the value (calibration runs, goldens). Instance data: never ships.
